title: Nā lā hānau, nā pāʻina a me nā hoaaloha
description: Ten short stories about birthdays, parties and friends in Hawaiʻi: a fourteenth birthday, a beach fire, a magic show, a thunderstorm, a ninetieth birthday, a pearl lei, a club election, a union picnic, a soccer final and a sunrise on Haleakalā.

lessons.title: Ka lā hānau ʻumikūmāhā
lessons.summary: Kauanoe turns fourteen; her friend Leolani helps her decorate the walls, they find there are not enough chairs, fill a box with drinks, and the fourteen guests each bring a card.
lessons.text:
ʻO ka Pōʻaono ka lā hānau ʻumikūmāhā o Kauanoe. Makemake ʻo ia e hana i kekahi pāʻina ma kona hale ma Kalāheo. Ua kākau ʻo ia i ʻumikūmāhā kāleka kono, a ua hāʻawi ʻo ia i kēlā me kēia kāleka i kekahi hoaaloha ma ke kula.

I ka Pōʻalima, ua hele mai kona hoaaloha ʻo Leolani e kōkua iā ia e hoʻonaninani i ka hale. "Ma hea kāua e hoʻomaka ai?" i nīnau ai ʻo Leolani. "Ma ka lumi nui," wahi a Kauanoe. "E kau kāua i nā lei pepa ma nā paia." Ua hoʻonaninani lāua i nā paia a pau me nā lei pepa ʻulaʻula a me nā pua. Nani loa nā paia.

Ma hope, ua helu ʻo Leolani i nā noho. "He ʻumi wale nō noho. ʻAʻole lawa nā noho no ʻumikūmāhā hoaaloha," wahi āna. "Ua lawa nō," wahi a Kauanoe. "E noho kekahi ma luna o nā moena ma waho."

A laila, ua hoʻopiha lāua i kekahi pahu nui i ka hau a me nā mea inu. "Aia ka wai hua ʻai i hea?" i nīnau ai ʻo Leolani. "Aia ia ma ka lumi kuke," wahi a Kauanoe. "E hoʻopiha kāua i ka pahu a piha loa. Inu nui koʻu mau hoaaloha!"

I ka Pōʻaono, ua hiki mai nā hoaaloha he ʻumikūmāhā. Ua lawe mai kēlā me kēia hoa i kekahi kāleka. Ua hoʻopiha ʻo Kauanoe i nā kīʻaha, a ua inu lākou a pau. Ua ʻai lākou i ka mea ʻono, a ua hīmeni lākou no Kauanoe.

Ma ka pō, ua heluhelu ʻo Kauanoe i kāna mau kāleka. "ʻO kēia kaʻu pāʻina maikaʻi loa," wahi āna i kona makuahine. "A ʻo kēia mau kāleka kaʻu makana maikaʻi loa."

Nā nīnau:
ʻEhia hoaaloha i kono ʻia e Kauanoe?
Ua kono ʻia he ʻumikūmāhā hoaaloha.
Ua hoʻonaninani lāua i nā paia me ka aha?
Ua hoʻonaninani lāua i nā paia me nā lei pepa a me nā pua.
Ua lawa nā noho no nā hoaaloha a pau?
ʻAʻole, ʻaʻole i lawa nā noho.
Aia ka wai hua ʻai i hea?
Aia ka wai hua ʻai ma ka lumi kuke.
He aha ka makana maikaʻi loa o Kauanoe?
ʻO nā kāleka kāna makana maikaʻi loa.

lessons.title: Ke ahi ma kahakai
lessons.summary: For Kahoʻokele's birthday he and two friends build a fire on the beach at Waimānalo with firewood and coconut fibre, turn a chicken over the flames, light torches as night falls, sing a soft song and put the fire out.
lessons.text:
No ka lā hānau o Kahoʻokele, ua hele ʻo ia me kona mau hoaaloha ʻelua, ʻo Pāoa lāua ʻo Kealamakia, i kahakai ma Waimānalo. Makemake lākou e kuke i ka moa hulihuli ma luna o ke ahi.

Ma ke ahiahi, ua ʻohi ʻo Pāoa i ka wahie ma ka ʻaoʻao o ke kahakai. Ua ʻohi ʻo Kealamakia i ka pulu niu maloʻo. "Pono kākou i ka pulu," wahi āna. "Wela koke ka pulu niu, a laila wela ka wahie." Ua puhi ʻo Kahoʻokele i ka pulu, a ua lilo ka wahie i ahi nui.

Ua kau lākou i ka moa ma luna o ke ahi, a ua hulihuli ʻo Pāoa i ka moa. "Pono e hulihuli mau i ka moa, i ʻole e pau i ke ahi," wahi āna.

Ua nalowale ka lā, a ua pouli ke kahakai. Ua puhi ʻo Kealamakia i ʻelua lama, a ua hoʻomālamalama nā lama i ke one. Ua hoʻomālamalama pū ke ahi i ko lākou mau maka. Ua anu ka makani o ka pō, no laila ua noho lākou kokoke i ke ahi.

Ua laʻi ke kai i kēlā pō. Ua hoʻokani ʻo Pāoa i ka pila, a ua hīmeni lākou i kekahi mele nahenahe. Nahenahe ka leo o Kealamakia. "He pō laʻi kēia, a he mele nahenahe kēia," wahi a Kahoʻokele. "ʻO kēia koʻu lā hānau maikaʻi loa."

Ma hope, ua pio kekahi lama i ka makani. Ua pouli hou. Ua hoʻopiha ʻo Pāoa i kekahi ipu i ka wai kai, a ua hoʻokahe ʻo ia i ka wai ma luna o ke ahi, i mea e pio loa ai ke ahi. Ua anu lākou, a ua hoʻi lākou i ke kaʻa.

Nā nīnau:
He aha kā Kealamakia i ʻohi ai?
Ua ʻohi ʻo ia i ka pulu niu maloʻo.
Na wai i hulihuli i ka moa?
Na Pāoa i hulihuli i ka moa.
He aha ka mea i hoʻomālamalama i ke one?
Ua hoʻomālamalama nā lama i ke one.
No ke aha lākou i noho ai kokoke i ke ahi?
Ua noho lākou kokoke i ke ahi no ka mea ua anu ka makani.
Pehea i pio ai ke ahi?
Ua pio ke ahi i ka wai kai a Pāoa i hoʻokahe ai.

lessons.title: Ke kanaka hoʻokalakupua
lessons.summary: At Keliʻihue's sixth birthday the boy dresses as a naughty fox, the magician Iokua pulls a ball from his belt, makes shadow pictures of a demigod and a giant on the wall, and makes a prophecy about Keliʻihue.
lessons.text:
ʻO kēia ka lā hānau ʻeono o Keliʻihue. Ua kono kona makuahine i kekahi kanaka hoʻokalakupua, ʻo Iokua, i ka pāʻina ma Pukalani.

Ua hele mai nā keiki me nā pāpale huinakolu ma ko lākou poʻo. Ua komo ʻo Keliʻihue i nā lole o ka ʻalopeke. "ʻO wau ka ʻalopeke kolohe!" wahi āna. Ua lawe ka ʻalopeke i nā pāpale huinakolu o nā keiki ʻē aʻe. Kolohe loa ʻo ia!

Ua hōʻea mai ʻo Iokua. Ua komo ʻo ia i kekahi kāʻei ʻeleʻele nui. Mai loko mai o kona kāʻei, ua lawe ʻo ia i kekahi pōpō ʻulaʻula. Ua nalowale ka pōpō, a ua loaʻa hou ia i loko o ka pāpale huinakolu o Keliʻihue. "Pohihihi!" wahi a nā keiki. "Pehea ʻo ia i hana ai i kēlā hoʻokalakupua?"

A laila, ua hoʻopau ʻo Iokua i nā kukui a pau, koe hoʻokahi. Ua hana ʻo ia i nā aka ma ka paia me kona mau lima. Ua ʻike nā keiki i ke aka o kekahi ʻalopeke. Ua haʻi ʻo Iokua i kekahi moʻolelo no Māui, ke kupua. Ua hana ʻo ia i ke aka o ke kupua, a laila i kekahi aka nui loa, he pilikua. Ua hakakā ke kupua me ka pilikua, a ua lanakila ke kupua.

Ma ka hopena, ua nānā ʻo Iokua iā Keliʻihue, a ua wānana ʻo ia: "I kekahi lā, e lilo ana ʻoe i kanaka hoʻokalakupua." Ua hauʻoli loa ʻo Keliʻihue i kēlā wānana. "E aʻo ana au i ka hoʻokalakupua," wahi āna.

Nā nīnau:
He aha ka mea ma ke poʻo o nā keiki?
He pāpale huinakolu ma ke poʻo o nā keiki.
Ua komo ʻo Keliʻihue i nā lole o ka aha?
Ua komo ʻo ia i nā lole o ka ʻalopeke.
Ua ʻike nā keiki i ke aka o wai ma ka paia?
Ua ʻike lākou i ke aka o ke kupua a me ke aka o ka pilikua.
He aha ka ʻōlelo a nā keiki i ka nalowale ʻana o ka pōpō?
Ua ʻōlelo lākou, "Pohihihi!"
He aha ka wānana a Iokua?
Ua wānana ʻo ia e lilo ana ʻo Keliʻihue i kanaka hoʻokalakupua.

lessons.title: Ka hekili
lessons.summary: At baby Kaʻiminani's first birthday in Mānoa she crawls after a toy robot and chews her spoon, then a peal of thunder shakes the windows, the guests rush about in confusion, and her grandfather calms her.
lessons.text:
ʻO kēia ka lā hānau mua o Kaʻiminani, ke kaikamahine a Halealoha. Ua hele mai ka ʻohana a me nā hoaaloha i ko lākou hale ma Mānoa. Hiki iā Kaʻiminani ke kolo wikiwiki ma ka papahele, akā ʻaʻole hiki iā ia ke hele wāwae. Ua kolo ʻo ia ma ka papahele a puni nā wāwae o nā malihini.

Ua hāʻawi kona kupuna kāne iā ia i kekahi lopako liʻiliʻi. Ua hele ka lopako ma ka papahele, a ua kolo ʻo Kaʻiminani ma hope o ka lopako, a ua ʻakaʻaka nā malihini a pau.

Ma ka ʻaina, ua hāʻawi ʻo Halealoha i kekahi puna i kāna kaikamahine. ʻAʻole i ʻai ke kaikamahine me ka puna. Ua mama wale nō ʻo ia i ka puna, e like me nā keiki liʻiliʻi a pau. "Mai mama i ka puna," wahi a Halealoha me ka ʻakaʻaka.

A laila, ua hiki mai nā ao ʻeleʻele ma luna o ke awāwa. Ua lohe ʻia kekahi kuʻina hekili nui. Ua haʻalulu nā puka aniani o ka hale, a ua haʻalulu pū nā kīʻaha ma luna o ka pākaukau. Ua wiwo ʻo Kaʻiminani, a ua kāhea ʻo ia i kona makuahine. Ua wiwo pū ka ʻīlio, a ua holo ʻo ia ma lalo o ka pākaukau.

Ua huikau nā malihini. Ua holo kekahi i waho e lawe mai i nā noho, a ua hāʻule kekahi kīʻaha ma ka papahele. Ua huikau ka hale a pau.

Ua lawe ke kupuna kāne iā Kaʻiminani ma kona mau lima. "Mai wiwo," wahi āna. "He leo wale nō ka hekili." Ua hāʻawi ʻo ia i ka lopako iā ia, a ua ʻakaʻaka hou ke kaikamahine. Ua lohe ʻia kekahi kuʻina hekili hou, akā ʻaʻole ʻo ia i wiwo.

Nā nīnau:
Pehea ʻo Kaʻiminani i hele ai ma ka papahele?
Ua kolo ʻo ia ma ka papahele.
He aha ka makana a kona kupuna kāne?
He lopako liʻiliʻi ka makana.
He aha kā Kaʻiminani i hana ai me ka puna?
Ua mama ʻo ia i ka puna.
He aha ka mea i haʻalulu ma hope o ke kuʻina hekili?
Ua haʻalulu nā puka aniani a me nā kīʻaha.
Ua wiwo ʻo Kaʻiminani i ke kuʻina hekili hope loa?
ʻAʻole, ʻaʻole ʻo ia i wiwo.

lessons.title: Nā makahiki he kanaiwa
lessons.summary: Kalāhiki, a native of Molokaʻi, celebrates his ninetieth birthday at the church hall in Kaunakakai; his granddaughter plays his old records, and he tells how, as a poor boy, he worked in the engine room of a steamship whose kind captain taught him to read.
lessons.text:
He kupa ʻo Kalāhiki no Molokaʻi. Ua hānau ʻia ʻo ia ma Kaunakakai i ka makahiki 1935, a i kēia makahiki, he 90 ona makahiki. Ua hana kāna mau keiki i kekahi pāʻina nui nona ma ka hale o ka ʻekalekia o ke kaona. Ua hele mai nā lālā o ka ʻekalekia, nā hoaaloha kahiko, a me nā kupa ʻē aʻe o ka mokupuni.

Ua lawe mai kāna moʻopuna, ʻo Kauwila, i nā lekoli kahiko o Kalāhiki, a ua hoʻokani ʻo ia i nā lekoli no nā malihini. He mau mele kahiko o Molokaʻi ma nā lekoli.

A laila, kū aʻela ʻo Kalāhiki, a haʻi aʻela ʻo ia i kekahi moʻolelo. "ʻIlihune koʻu ʻohana i koʻu wā ʻōpio. No ko mākou ʻilihune, ua hele au e hana ma luna o kekahi mokuahi. Ua hana au ma ka lumi ʻenekini. Wela loa ka ʻenekini, a ua hana mākou i ke ao a me ka pō. Ua holo ka mokuahi ma waena o Molokaʻi a me Honolulu."

"He kanaka lokomaikaʻi ke kāpena o ka mokuahi. Ua ʻike ke kāpena ʻaʻole hiki iaʻu ke heluhelu, a ua aʻo ʻo ia iaʻu i ka heluhelu ʻana i kēlā me kēia ahiahi. I kekahi lā, ua hiki mai ka lono ua make ke kāpena. Ua hoʻokaumaha nui kēlā lono iaʻu."

"Akā, mai ʻae i kēia moʻolelo e hoʻokaumaha iā kākou," wahi āna. "Ua ʻilihune au i ke kālā, akā ua waiwai au i ka ʻohana a me nā hoaaloha. A i kēia lā, he lono maikaʻi kaʻu: e male ana kaʻu moʻopuna, ʻo Kauwila, i kēia makahiki!" Ua hauʻoli nā malihini a pau.

Ua hoʻokani hou ʻo Kauwila i kekahi lekoli. Kū aʻela ka wahine a Kalāhiki, a ua hula lāua i mua o nā malihini.

Nā nīnau:
Ua hānau ʻia ʻo Kalāhiki i hea?
Ua hānau ʻia ʻo ia ma Kaunakakai ma Molokaʻi.
Ua hana ʻia ka pāʻina i hea?
Ua hana ʻia ka pāʻina ma ka hale o ka ʻekalekia.
Ua hana ʻo Kalāhiki ma hea o ka mokuahi?
Ua hana ʻo ia ma ka lumi ʻenekini.
Na wai i aʻo iā Kalāhiki i ka heluhelu ʻana?
Na ke kāpena o ka mokuahi i aʻo iā ia.
He aha ka lono i hoʻokaumaha iā ia?
ʻO ka lono ua make ke kāpena.

lessons.title: Ka lei momi
lessons.summary: Keliʻikoa hopes to buy a pearl lei for Nohelani's birthday, finds that with the tax he cannot afford the first one, buys a smaller one with a single pearl in the middle, gives it to her at dinner, and explains that lana in his card means hope in that context.
lessons.text:
E hiki mai ana ka lā hānau o Nohelani, ka ipo a Keliʻikoa. Lana ka manaʻo o Keliʻikoa e kūʻai i kekahi lei momi nona.

Ua hele ʻo ia i kekahi hale kūʻai ma Honolulu. Ma ke kihi o ka hale kūʻai, aia kekahi pahu aniani me nā lei momi. Ua nānā ʻo ia i kekahi lei me hoʻokahi momi nui ma ke kūwaena a me nā momi liʻiliʻi ma nā ʻaoʻao. "ʻEhia ke kumukūʻai?" wahi āna. "He $300, a me ka ʻauhau," wahi a ka wahine kūʻai.

Me ka ʻauhau, ʻoi aku ke kumukūʻai ma mua o $300. ʻAʻole lawa kāna kālā. Akā, lana mau kona manaʻo. Ua hōʻike ka wahine kūʻai iā ia i kekahi lei liʻiliʻi aʻe, me hoʻokahi momi wale nō ma ke kūwaena. Ua lawa kāna kālā no kēlā lei a me ka ʻauhau.

Ma ka lā hānau, ua hele lāua i kekahi hale ʻaina. Ua noho lāua ma kekahi pākaukau ma ke kihi. Ua lawe mai ka mea lawelawe i ka palaoa mehana. ʻOno loa ka palaoa. A laila, ua ʻai lāua i ka iʻa me nā ʻō a me nā pahi. Ua hāʻule kekahi ʻō ma ka papahele, a ua lawe mai ka mea lawelawe i kekahi ʻō hou.

Ma hope o ka ʻaina, ua hāʻawi ʻo Keliʻikoa i kekahi pahu liʻiliʻi iā Nohelani. Ua wehe ʻo Nohelani i ka pahu, a ua hoʻokau ʻo Keliʻikoa i ka lei ma kona ʻāʻī. "Nani loa kēia momi," wahi āna. "Mahalo nui, e kuʻu ipo."

Ma ke kāleka, ua kākau ʻo Keliʻikoa, "Lana koʻu manaʻo e noho pū kāua a mau loa." Ua nīnau ʻo Nohelani, "Lana ka moku ma ke kai. He aha ke ʻano o 'lana' ma ʻaneʻi?" "Ma kēia pōʻaiapili, ʻo ka manaʻolana ke ʻano," wahi a Keliʻikoa. "Pili ke ʻano o kekahi ʻōlelo i kona pōʻaiapili."

Nā nīnau:
No ke aha ʻaʻole i lawa ke kālā o Keliʻikoa no ka lei mua?
No ka mea, ʻoi aku ke kumukūʻai me ka ʻauhau ma mua o $300.
Ua hoʻokau ʻo Keliʻikoa i ka lei ma hea?
Ua hoʻokau ʻo ia i ka lei ma ka ʻāʻī o Nohelani.
He aha ke ʻano o "lana" ma ka pōʻaiapili o ke kāleka?
ʻO ka manaʻolana ke ʻano o "lana" ma kēlā pōʻaiapili.

lessons.title: Ka ʻahahui kālaimeaola
lessons.summary: Before the farewell party for their teacher, the school biology club in Kailua chooses between two candidates for president; Kaʻohulani wins by promising to continue the teacher's albatross project, and Nāwaʻa collects the resources for the party.
lessons.text:
He lālā ʻo Kaʻohulani no ka ʻahahui kālaimeaola o kona kula ma Kailua. Aloha nui nā lālā o ka ʻahahui i ko lākou kumu kālaimeaola, ʻo Kumu Kahue. I kēia makahiki, e haʻalele ana ʻo ia i ke kula e aʻo i ka kālaimeaola ma kekahi kulanui ma Kauaʻi, a ua manaʻo ka ʻahahui e hana i kekahi pāʻina nona.

Akā, ma mua o ka pāʻina, pono e koho i kekahi pelekikena hou no ka ʻahahui. ʻElua moho: ʻo Kaʻohulani a me kekahi keikikāne, ʻo Nāwaʻa. Ua ʻōlelo ʻo Nāwaʻa, "Inā e koho ʻoukou iaʻu, e hana au i ka pāʻina maikaʻi loa." Ua ʻōlelo ʻo Kaʻohulani, "Inā e koho ʻoukou iaʻu, e hoʻomau kākou i ka pāhana kaʻupu a Kumu Kahue."

No ka pāhana, ua hele nā lālā i Kaʻena i kēlā me kēia mahina e helu i nā kaʻupu. Ua kākau lākou i ka helu o nā kaʻupu a me kā lākou mau hua i loko o kekahi pūnaehana kamepiula. Na Kumu Kahue i hana i kēlā pūnaehana.

Ua koho ʻia ʻo Kaʻohulani i pelekikena. ʻAʻole nui nā kumuwaiwai o ka ʻahahui, no laila ua pūkuʻi ʻo Nāwaʻa i nā kumuwaiwai mai nā lālā a pau: ua pūkuʻi ʻo ia i ke kālā, ua lawe mai kekahi i ka ʻai, a ua lawe mai kekahi i nā noho.

Ua kākau ʻo Kaʻohulani i kekahi leka kūheluna mai ka ʻahahui iā Kumu Kahue. Ma lalo, ua kākau ʻo ia i kona inoa kūheluna hou: "Pelekikena o ka ʻAhahui Kālaimeaola." Ua heluhelu ʻo ia i ka leka ma ka pāʻina. Ma hope, ua kau ʻo Nāwaʻa i nā kiʻi o ka pāʻina ma ka moʻokāki o ka ʻahahui. Ua nānā nā haumāna kahiko i nā kiʻi ma ka moʻokāki.

Nā nīnau:
ʻO wai nā moho ʻelua?
ʻO Kaʻohulani lāua ʻo Nāwaʻa nā moho ʻelua.
He aha ka pāhana a Kumu Kahue?
He pāhana no nā kaʻupu ma Kaʻena.
Ua kākau nā lālā i nā helu ma hea?
Ua kākau lākou i nā helu i loko o kekahi pūnaehana kamepiula.
Na wai i pūkuʻi i nā kumuwaiwai no ka pāʻina?
Na Nāwaʻa i pūkuʻi i nā kumuwaiwai.
Ua kau ʻia nā kiʻi ma hea?
Ua kau ʻia nā kiʻi ma ka moʻokāki o ka ʻahahui.

lessons.title: Ka lā hānau o ka uniona
lessons.summary: A hotel workers' union celebrates its fiftieth birthday with a family picnic on a ten-acre farm in Waimānalo: the members build a platform for the hula, set out tables under the trees, Kealohi and her father dig a hole for a breadfruit tree given as an offering, and a member back from Rapa Nui shows photos of the moʻai.
lessons.text:
He lālā ʻo Kanoho no ka uniona o nā limahana hōkele ma Honolulu. I kēia makahiki, he 50 makahiki o ka uniona, a ua hana ka uniona i kekahi pāʻina nui no nā lālā a me ko lākou ʻohana. Ua hana ʻia ka pāʻina ma kekahi mahiʻai ma Waimānalo. He ʻumi ʻeka ka nui o ka mahiʻai: ʻelima ʻeka o nā meakanu, a ʻelima ʻeka o ka mauʻu.

I ke kakahiaka, ua hoʻokūkulu nā lālā i kekahi paepae lāʻau ma waena o ka mauʻu, i mea e hula ai nā keiki ma luna o ka paepae. A laila, ua hoʻonoho lākou i nā pākaukau a me nā noho ma ka malu o nā kumulāʻau. Ua hoʻonoho ke kaikamahine a Kanoho, ʻo Kealohi, i nā pua ma luna o kēlā me kēia pākaukau.

Ma ka ʻaina, ua hāʻawi ka uniona i kekahi hoʻokupu i ka mea nona ka mahiʻai: he kumulāʻau ʻulu ʻōpio. "He hoʻokupu kēia no kou lokomaikaʻi," wahi a ka pelekikena o ka uniona. Ua ʻeli ʻo Kanoho lāua ʻo Kealohi i kekahi lua ma ka ʻaoʻao o ka hale. Ua ʻeli lāua a hohonu ka lua, a laila ua kanu lāua i ke kumulāʻau.

Ma hope o ka ʻaina, ua hōʻike kekahi lālā, ʻo Kaʻaiōkai, i nā kiʻi o kāna huakaʻi i Rapanui. Ma nā kiʻi, he mau moʻai pōhaku nunui. "Ua kālai ʻia nā moʻai e nā kānaka kahiko o ka mokupuni," wahi āna. "Nui aʻe kekahi moʻai ma mua o ka hale."

Ma ke ahiahi, ua hula nā keiki ma luna o ka paepae. Ma hope o ka pāʻina, ua kiola nā keiki i ka ʻōpala i loko o nā pahu.

Nā nīnau:
ʻEhia ʻeka ka nui o ka mahiʻai?
He ʻumi ʻeka ka nui o ka mahiʻai.
He aha ka mea i hoʻokūkulu ʻia no ka hula?
Ua hoʻokūkulu ʻia kekahi paepae lāʻau.
Ua hoʻonoho ʻia nā pākaukau ma hea?
Ua hoʻonoho ʻia nā pākaukau ma ka malu o nā kumulāʻau.
He aha ka hoʻokupu a ka uniona?
He kumulāʻau ʻulu ʻōpio ka hoʻokupu.
Ua kiola nā keiki i ka ʻōpala i hea?
Ua kiola lākou i ka ʻōpala i loko o nā pahu.
He aha ka mea ma nā kiʻi o Kaʻaiōkai?
He mau moʻai pōhaku nunui ma nā kiʻi.

lessons.title: Ka mekala
lessons.summary: In the final game of the season, Kekuewa's Kāneʻohe soccer team is annoyed by a rough opponent; with only seconds left he heads in the winning goal, ending with a swollen forehead, and at the party his teammate Tamati from Aotearoa talks about his land's history as a colony.
lessons.text:
Pāʻani ʻo Kekuewa i ka pōwāwae ma kekahi hui o Kāneʻohe. ʻO Lauakea ke kaʻi o ka hui. I kēia Pōʻaono, ʻo ka pāʻani hope loa o ke kau, a ʻo ia pū ka lā hānau o ke kaʻi.

Ma ka pāʻani, ua hoʻonāukiuki kekahi keikikāne o ka hui ʻē aʻe iā Kekuewa. Ua kū ʻo ia ma luna o nā wāwae o Kekuewa, a ua ʻōlelo ʻino ʻo ia iā ia. "Mai ʻae iā ia e hoʻonāukiuki iā ʻoe," wahi a ke kaʻi. "Pāʻani wale nō i ka pōwāwae."

Ua like nā helu o nā hui ʻelua. He 30 kekona wale nō i koe. Ua hoʻolei kona hoa, ʻo Tamati, i ka pōpō i luna, a ua lele ʻo Kekuewa a ua kuʻi ʻo ia i ka pōpō me kona lae. Ua komo ka pōpō i loko o ka pahu! Ma hope o ʻumi kekona, ua pau ka pāʻani. Ua lanakila ko Kekuewa hui. Akā ua pehupehu kona lae, a ua wili ʻo ia i kona wāwae i kona hāʻule ʻana. Ua hāʻawi ke kaʻi i ka hau no kona lae pehupehu.

Ma ka pāʻina ma hope, ua hāʻawi ʻia ka mekala i kēlā me kēia keiki o ka hui. Ua hāʻawi ka hui i kekahi mekala nui i ke kaʻi no kona lā hānau. No Aotearoa mai ʻo Tamati. "Ma mua, he kolone ʻo Aotearoa," wahi a Tamati. "Ua hoʻokolonaio ʻo Pelekānia i ko mākou ʻāina. Ua lilo ka ʻāina o nā Māori i nā malihini. Ua hoʻokolonaio ʻia ʻo Hawaiʻi kekahi?" "ʻAʻole ʻo Hawaiʻi i lilo i kolone," wahi a Kekuewa, "akā ua lilo ko mākou ʻāina i ʻAmelika."

Nā nīnau:
ʻO wai ke kaʻi o ka hui pōwāwae?
ʻO Lauakea ke kaʻi o ka hui.
Ua kuʻi ʻo Kekuewa i ka pōpō me ka aha?
Ua kuʻi ʻo ia i ka pōpō me kona lae.
He aha ka mea i hāʻawi ʻia i ke kaʻi no kona lā hānau?
Ua hāʻawi ʻia kekahi mekala nui iā ia.
Ua aha ʻo Kekuewa i kona wāwae?
Ua wili ʻo ia i kona wāwae i kona hāʻule ʻana.
Na wai i hoʻokolonaio iā Aotearoa?
Na Pelekānia i hoʻokolonaio iā Aotearoa.
Na wai i hoʻonāukiuki iā Kekuewa?
Na kekahi keikikāne o ka hui ʻē aʻe i hoʻonāukiuki iā ia.

lessons.title: Ka wēkiu o Haleakalā
lessons.summary: For Kahiʻau's twentieth birthday she and her friend Uʻilani drive to the summit of Haleakalā to watch the sunrise, see the sun melt the frost, walk one by one down into the crater following the trail markers, and download their phone photos at home.
lessons.text:
No ka lā hānau iwakālua o Kahiʻau, ua manaʻo ʻo ia me kona hoaaloha ʻo Uʻilani e ʻike i ka puka ʻana o ka lā ma ka wēkiu o Haleakalā. Ua haʻalele lāua i ka hale ma Pukalani i ka hola 3 o ke kakahiaka, a ua holo lāua i ke kaʻa a hiki i ka wēkiu.

Ma ka wēkiu, ua anu loa. Lipo ka lani, a ua ʻike lāua i nā hōkū he nui ma ka lani lipo. Ma luna o ke kaʻa, he hau keʻokeʻo. I ka puka ʻana mai o ka lā, ua ʻulaʻula ka lani, a ua hoʻoheheʻe ka lā i ka hau ma luna o ke kaʻa. Ua lawe ʻo Kahiʻau i nā kiʻi he nui me kona kelepona paʻalima. "E nānā i ka lā e hoʻoheheʻe ana i ka hau," wahi āna.

Ma hope, ua iho lāua i loko o ka luapele. Nui loa ka luapele, a ʻulaʻula a ʻeleʻele kona lepo. Ma ke ala, he mau māka ma nā pōhaku, a ua hahai lāua i nā māka. Ua ʻōlelo ʻo Uʻilani, "Pono kāua e makaʻala. Inā ʻaʻohe māka, mai hele."

Ma kekahi wahi, ua liʻiliʻi loa ke ala. Ua hele pākahi lāua: ʻo Uʻilani ma mua, a ʻo Kahiʻau ma hope. Ua hele pākahi nā kānaka ʻē aʻe ma ke ala. Ua makaʻala lāua ma ka ʻaoʻao o ka pali. Ma lalo o ka luapele, ua hoʻoiho lāua i kā lāua mau pahu ʻai, a ua ʻai lāua.

Ma ke ahiahi, ma ka hale, ua hoʻoiho ʻo Kahiʻau i nā kiʻi mai kona kelepona paʻalima i kona kamepiula. Ua hoʻoiho pū ʻo Uʻilani i nā kiʻi mai kona kelepona paʻalima. "ʻO kēia koʻu lā hānau maikaʻi loa," wahi a Kahiʻau.

Nā nīnau:
Ua hele ʻo Kahiʻau lāua ʻo Uʻilani i hea?
Ua hele lāua i ka wēkiu o Haleakalā.
Pehea ka lani ma ka wēkiu?
Lipo ka lani, a he nui nā hōkū.
Na ka aha i hoʻoheheʻe i ka hau ma luna o ke kaʻa?
Na ka lā i hoʻoheheʻe i ka hau.
He aha kā lāua i hahai ai ma ka luapele?
Ua hahai lāua i nā māka ma nā pōhaku.
Ua hoʻoiho ʻo Kahiʻau i nā kiʻi i hea?
Ua hoʻoiho ʻo ia i nā kiʻi i kona kamepiula.
